title: 10 Years of DSPT: Roundtable + Celebration
description:
**Data Science Portugal (DSPT) is celebrating its 10th anniversary! 🎉**

DSPT is officially hitting double digits (watch out, teenage years are right around the corner!) and we are celebrating hard! 🎂

On **October 10th (10/10) in Porto,** join us for a **roundtable with the founders and early speakers of DSPT**, followed by an amazing **birthday party!**

We'll be looking to discuss just how Data Science and Artificial Intelligence have changed in Portugal over the past 10 years. We'll be hearing directly from those who have already been in the field for a long time. Some nostalgia will certainly be in the mix!

**🗣️ Joining the roundtable:**
• Rita Ribeiro (FCUP)
• Rui Quintino (agentiaPT)
• Pedro Chaves (OLX)
• Rui Mendes (DareData)
• Inês Silva (Feedzai)

The conversation will be moderated by Leonid Kholkine (DareData).

title: Building Agentic AI: Essential Design Patterns | Workshop + Challenge
description:
**Data Science Portugal (DSPT) is celebrating its 10th anniversary! 🎉**

DSPT is officially hitting double digits (watch out, teenage years are right around the corner!) and we are celebrating hard! 🎂

On **October 10th (10/10) in Porto,** we are taking over the afternoon for a special **hands-on session focused on Agentic AI,** essential **design patterns,** and **hands-on development with AI agents.**

This event is for developers, data scientists, and AI builders who want to stop treating LLMs merely as conversational chatbots and start building real autonomous systems that perceive, decide, and act through tools 💡

**🧠 What’s going to happen?**
Over the course of the afternoon, participants will:
• Take part in a deep-dive talk and workshop: **Building Agentic AI: Essential Design Patterns** led by **Ricardo Pereira** (U. Coimbra)
• Work in teams to tackle a **practical challenge**
• Use **GenAI tools** to speed up development and explore creative approaches
• **Pitch** their final solution in a short presentation
• **Vote** for the winning project 🎉
🏆 **The winning team will receive tickets to Porto Tech Hub 2026!**

**👥 Who is this event for?**
This workshop is geared toward practitioners and builders who want to look under the hood of autonomous agent architectures:
**• Intermediate Python knowledge is required**
• Curiosity and a willingness to build and experiment with autonomous workflows are essential 💪

You can:
• Sign up with friends in **teams of 3–4 people**, or
• **Join on your own**, and we’ll help you form a team on the day.

**🗓️ Agenda**
14:00–14:30 · Check-in & welcome by DSPT
14:30–15:30 · Building Agentic AI: Essential Design Patterns, with Ricardo Pereira
15:30–17:30 · Team development challenge
17:30–18:15 · Project pitches
18:15–18:30 · Voting & winner reveal

**💻 What to bring**
• Your laptop and charger
• Python 3.10+ installed and ready

**📌 Spots are limited.** Join us for an afternoon of learning, building, and meeting other people working with AI!
